notes: Background: mid-market PM/product analytics SaaS. Multi-tenant UI + inference features for agent and search.
Initial path: started on Redwood Hosted API (trial) for embeddings & chat in June 2025 — satisfied with latency and token cost during small volume tests.
Motivation for Dedicated: predictable throughput for peak build workflows, tighter VPC integration, and audit/KMS controls for customer data.
Quote from CTO (2025-09-03): 'We need a path to dedicated capacity that won't double our unit token cost — show us throughput guarantees and rollback plan.'
Recent demo (2025-08-20): Jordan + Priya ran a Dedicated architecture walkthrough; infra liked autoscaling + canary options. SE answered KV cache / quantization questions.
Security call (2025-09-02): discussed SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, SSO/SAML flows, and retention controls. Security requested architecture diagram + encryption-in-transit + key rotation plan.
POC objective: 4-week Dedicated POC in their AWS account (VPC), prove 100 r/s sustained with p50 < 200ms for chat generation, embeddings throughput 350 req/min, and cost forecast compared to Hosted.
POC scope (draft):
- Week 0: infra onboarding, VPC peering, KMS keys, RBAC and SSO test account
- Week 1: deploy model variant A (open/quantized) behind Dedicated pool; run synthetic load; measure latency/throughput
- Week 2: canary rollout of model variant B (higher-fidelity) on 10% traffic; run fallback policies to variant A for cost spikes
- Week 3: region failover test (NA -> EU staging) for DR; measure cold-start + KV cache warmup; run rollback scenario
- Week 4: quality evaluation vs production prompts, cost reconciliation, sign-off
Canary + fallback plan (requested):
- Canary traffic: start at 2% -> 10% over 48h with error/latency SLO gate
- Fallback triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency spike > 2x baseline -> automatic fallback to variant A and alert
- Rollback: automated rollback job if quality regression detected by eval harness (prompt-set pass rate drop > 3%)
Model variants: pref test variants: 'open-7B-quant' (cost baseline) and 'open-16B-fp16' (higher quality). Redwood SE recommended middle-ground quantized 13B for canary.

Routing requirements: route by policy to minimize cost while meeting latency SLOs; want region-aware routing (prefer NA for US customers, EU for EU customers) and automatic failover to second region if capacity low.

Acceptance criteria: latency targets (p50<200ms), error rate <0.5%, sustained throughput target reached for 6 hours, cost delta within 1.5x Hosted forecast, successful key rotation and audit log ingestion into their Splunk dev stack.
Commercial: discussed Dedicated committed tiers and burst pricing. Finance wants a 90-day POC price cap; Jordan to provide a POC quote by 2025-09-15.
